t.E416.agn: In 2016 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at current uses (the SCF had previously set an ADI of 12.5 mg/kg). EFSA stated that the level of 7,000 mg per day, at which abdominal discomfort was seen in some adults, should not be exceeded through this additive.
t.E416.body: Karaya gum is practically not digested, is not broken down by gut bacteria and is most probably not absorbed.
t.E416.found.1: Fillings and toppings for bakery products and desserts
t.E416.found.2: Potato- and cereal-based snacks, coatings for nuts
t.E416.prod: Obtained by physical means from plant seeds or tree exudate (gum).
t.E416.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed. It was recommended that 7,000 mg per day not be exceeded in adults.
t.E416.summary: A natural gum obtained from the resin of the karaya tree. Used as a thickener.
t.E416.what: Thickens, forms gels and keeps mixtures stable.
